features.label: Interchangeable Pads for Versatility
features.text: Compatible with Knee Pad, Shoulder Pad, and Universal Pad for targeted relief across different body areas (sold separately).

features.label: Adjustable Therapy Levels
features.text: Control cold (≥45°F to ≥50°F) and compression (Low to Regular) settings to suit your comfort and recovery needs.

features.label: Portable Design
features.text: Lightweight and compact system with integrated hose management for easy transport and storage.

features.label: Quiet Performance
features.text: Whisper-quiet pump ensures a peaceful therapy experience, perfect for home or clinical use.

features.label: Easy to Operate
features.text: Intuitive controls and simple setup let you start your therapy quickly and effortlessly.

measurement: Knee Pad: 16" x 12", fitting knee circumferences of 8"-27". Shoulder Pad: 15" x 13", accommodating shoulder circumferences up to 50". Universal Pad: 13" x 12.5", designed for use on multiple body areas including the knee, back, shoulder, and chest.
